articles.title: These Dividend Stocks and Funds Are Worth a Trip Abroad
articles.mainIdea: These Dividend Stocks and Funds Are Worth a Trip Abroad
articles.summary: Barrons.com: These Dividend Stocks and Funds Are Worth a Trip Abroad. A weakening dollar has helped lift returns, along with a rotation out of mega-cap technology stocks. Foreign markets are cheaper than their U.S. counterparts, reflecting their relative lack of Big Tech companies and emphasis on old-economy sectors like financials, industrials, and consumer goods. Related tickers mentioned: DVYE, FEORX, FESOX, IDV, SGOIX, SGOVX, VGTSX, VIHAX, VTIAX, VTISX, VTPSX, VTSNX, VXUS, VYMI.
